description: 🆕 An ERC-20 balance on Base, in raw units and in decimals, with the token's symbol and decimals resolved in the same call. Zero is flagged explicitly, since it is the commonest answer and the one most easily confused with a failed read. An address that doesn't implement balanceOf answers found:false and says so.
name: token_balance

checkedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of when the underlying reads were taken.
